so i ship amsterdam boutique hotels a free sample built on their own data.

the sample isn't the product. the company brain behind it is: agents covering the desk hours they can't hire, priced on margin they win back on nights they already sell.

a 20-room amsterdam boutique hotel: one person on reception, email, reviews and the instagram.

i ship a free sample to prove it first.
